summary.text: Auchincloss is the incumbent, serving since 2021. A Harvard graduate and Marine Corps veteran, he worked in product development in the insurance and cybersecurity sectors and served on the Newton City Council before winning his seat in 2020. He serves on the House Energy and Commerce Committee.

paragraphs.text: Born in 1988, according to Ballotpedia, and raised in Newton, Massachusetts, the son of a surgeon and a scientist, according to his official biography.

Earned a bachelor's degree in government and economics from Harvard College (2010) and an M.B.A. from MIT (2016); his official biography cites degrees in economics and finance from Harvard and MIT Sloan.
Served in the U.S. Marine Corps from 2010 to 2015, reaching the rank of captain; his official biography says he commanded infantry in Afghanistan and special operations in Panama.
Worked in business while serving on the city council, including as a product manager at a cybersecurity startup and in new-products management at Liberty Mutual Insurance's Solaria Labs.
Served on the Newton, Massachusetts City Council from 2016 to 2020 before his election to Congress.
Took office in January 2021 and is serving his third term; he sits on the House Energy and Commerce Committee.
Belongs to caucuses including the Pro-Choice Caucus, the LGBTQ+ Equality Caucus, the Telehealth Caucus, and the Defense Spending Reduction Caucus, according to his official committees page.
According to his official biography, he lives in Newton with his wife, Michelle, and their three children.
